correctness.rationale: Vertices in one zero block are open twins and vertices in one one block have equal outside traces when both omitted, so at most one omission per block is necessary. The displayed traces of omitted \(A_i\)- and \(B_j\)-vertices are correct from the threshold creation order. Pairwise comparison of these traces gives exactly conditions 1--5: nonempty traces, separation of consecutive omitted zero blocks, separation of consecutive omitted one blocks, and cross-type separation. Consecutive checks suffice by nesting. The coefficient weight is exactly the number of choices of omitted representatives, and the twin-thick factorization follows because every relevant block retains a selected vertex after one omission.
